using System;

        private MigrateSession CreateSessionWithLogger(out Mock<ILogger> loggerMock)
        {
            loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var session = (MigrateSession)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(MigrateSession), true)!;
            // Use reflection to set the private logger field
            var loggerField = typeof(MigrateSession).GetField("logger", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            loggerField.SetValue(session, loggerMock.Object);

            // Setup other required private fields to avoid null refs
            var migrateOperationField = typeof(MigrateSession).GetField("migrateOperation", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            var clientMock = new Mock<IClient>();
            clientMock.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object>())).Returns(Task.FromResult("OK"));
            migrateOperationField.SetValue(session, new[] { new { Client = clientMock.Object } });

            var timeoutField = typeof(MigrateSession).GetField("_timeout", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            timeoutField.SetValue(session, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(100));

            var ctsField = typeof(MigrateSession).GetField("_cts", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            ctsField.SetValue(session, new CancellationTokenSource());

            var slotRangesField = typeof(MigrateSession).GetField("_slotRanges", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            slotRangesField.SetValue(session, new object());

            var sslotsField = typeof(MigrateSession).GetField("_sslots", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            sslotsField.SetValue(session, new int[0]);

            var clusterManagerType = typeof(MigrateSession).Assembly.GetType("Garnet.cluster.ClusterManager");
            var clusterManagerGetRangeMethod = clusterManagerType?.GetMethod("GetRange", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static);
            // We cannot mock static method easily, so we skip verifying the exact call parameters

            return session;
        }

        {

    internal interface IClient

        Task<string> SetSlotRange(byte[] stateBytes, string nodeid, object slotRanges);

        IMPORT,
        STABLE,
        NODE,
        FAIL,
        SUCCESS

            // Set private readonly migrateOperation field to array with one element with Client property set to clientMock.Object
